answer: A synchronous individuality ceremony stops bulk fake identities by putting every identity in one ten-minute window. All identities gather in an open meadow hall at one announced time. One ember signal starts the same puzzle for everyone at once. Each seat answers alone, and each sheet carries a unique pigment mark for that seat. One person cannot sit in two seats, so a stand-in is exposed when timing clusters. The k-th fake still needs a k-th stand-in at 5 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 5,000 credits per round. An honest agent attends once and keeps the full reward share.
